name: cowgirl-lying-fashion-portrait
image_purpose: fashion lookbook and western editorial portrait

prompt.project_info: Create a hyper-realistic raw studio portrait of one original approved adult woman lying prone on a neutral taupe floor in western fashion styling.
prompt.main_subject: Original approved adult woman with long straight light-brown to brunette hair draped over the shoulders, calm confident gaze, subtle winged eyeliner, natural skin finish without smoothing, and visible natural texture. She wears a large structured beige felt cowboy hat with a distinct crown and wide brim, a sleeveless brown-bronze fitted bodysuit, dark brown leather cowboy boots with western stitching and worn soles, and a delicate chain necklace with a thin gold bracelet.
composition_elements: Subject lies prone on her stomach with legs bent upward and boots raised behind her.
Left arm is propped up with a loose fist under the chin or cheek to support the head; front-facing eye-level composition.
Seamless solid neutral beige or taupe studio backdrop and floor with warm earth-tone palette.
Hat brim casts a dramatic shadow across the upper face while boot leather grain and scuffed soles remain visible.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Dramatic chiaroscuro with directional soft light from the left at approximately 5500K, deep hat shadow across the upper face, soft floor shadows, natural color grading, and subtle film grain.
prompt.technical_specs: Photorealistic 4:5 portrait, Sony A7R V look, 85mm f/1.4 GM at f/2.8, ISO 100, 1/125s, sharp eye and face focus with creamy background falloff, 8K RAW-style detail, tactile felt, skin, fabric, and leather texture, no text or watermark.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: A hyper-realistic raw studio portrait of one original approved adult woman lying on her stomach, shot with a Sony A7R V look and 85mm f/1.4 lens at f/2.8. She has long straight light-brown to brunette hair draped over her shoulders, a calm confident gaze, subtle winged eyeliner, natural unsmoothed skin texture, and wears a large beige felt cowboy hat casting a dramatic shadow over her upper face, a sleeveless brown-bronze fitted bodysuit, and worn dark-brown leather cowboy boots with western stitching and visible scuffed soles. Her legs are bent with boots raised behind her, and she rests her chin on a loose fist while gazing toward camera. Use dramatic chiaroscuro with directional soft light from the left at 5500K, seamless neutral beige-taupe floor and backdrop, deep hat shadow, soft floor shadows, 8K RAW-style detail, ISO 100, f/2.8, 1/125s, natural color grading, subtle film grain, no text, no watermark.
